svg.title: Which Turbonomic edition fits
svg.desc: The three editions as IBM names them. Turbonomic SaaS: IBM hosts and manages it, in multiple regions. Turbonomic On-premise: self-hosted, in your own data center or a cloud-based Kubernetes cluster. Turbonomic Parking Edition: SaaS that parks idle workloads on AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud automatically.
